summary: Inspected all 31 listed .lean files under HexIntFactor and HexIntFactorMathlib. Every file contains formal mathematical content: definitions, structures, theorems, proofs, certificate data with kernel-checked acceptance (by decide +kernel), meta-programming for certificate export/import, or test conformance with #guard directives. Two files (HexIntFactor/Replay.lean and HexIntFactor/Mixed/Replay.lean) are pure import aggregators containing only a module declaration, a single public import, and a comment — but per FILTER-007 these are navigation modules that should be ranked (navigation-import-only), not hard-excluded from the primary index. No file meets the FILTER-004 hard-exclusion bar (no declarations/proofs of its own with auxiliary channel verified). The default retain disposition applies to all 31 files.
